title: October 9, 1949: India created an army of citizens who kept their day jobs.

sources.text: Press Information Bureau - Indian Army Celebrates 73rd Raising Day of Territorial Army on 09 October 2022

caption:
October 9, 1949: India created an army of citizens who kept their day jobs.

As India's first Indian Governor-General, Rajagopalachari launched the Territorial Army under the Territorial Army Act of 1948 - a volunteer 'second line of defence' made up of ordinary citizens with regular civilian careers, who train for military service and can be mobilized in national emergencies.

October 9 is observed every year as Territorial Army Day. The force remains one of the few institutions where a civilian career and military readiness are meant to coexist, not compete.

The Territorial Army's citizen-soldier model is a quiet reminder that national defence doesn't always require a standing army at full size - sometimes it requires a standing offer.
